name: Mightride
description: Shorten the horse's last stride to bring it cleanly into the narrow gap of a broken file.

name: Veritygraper
description: Slope the lance over the shoulder and scan the enemy rank for its weakest shield.

name: Rumble Ride
description: Jab the point into the joint between two enemy shields to pry them apart.

name: Gust Lanceguard
description: Keep the rest steady through contact so the shaft does not slide back under the arm.

name: Irongraper
description: Drive qi forward through the lance so point and horse's shoulder open a wedge in the line.

name: Impactcloak
description: Sweep the shaft sideways with qi along its length to push two enemy shields aside together.

name: Gust Arrestrest
description: Pour a rising wave of qi along the shaft in the last three strides so contact cracks the front rank apart.

name: Impacthauberk
description: Turn the horse's shoulder into the broken gap and hold the rank from closing behind the charge.

name: Chime Couchrest
description: Sight along the lance over the horse's poll and align the point on the target's belt.

name: Mindful Graper
description: Brace both feet hard in the stirrups so the legs carry the shaft's weight.

name: Gust Tilt
description: Strike the enemy's cuirass at its flattest point so the full weight of the charge turns into force.

name: Torrent Lanceshaft
description: Hold the lance high and angled to take mace blows on the thick part of the shaft.

name: Blurring Shatter
description: Wheel to the right after the pass and reform the line beside the nearest rider.

name: Saddletorment
description: Time a hard exhale of qi to the instant of contact so the point punches through cuirass plate.

name: Daybreak Lancehead
description: Send qi into the arm and rest to keep a heavy lance level for a long run.

name: Charter Bellrest
description: Cross shaft and horse's neck in a wedge of qi-hardened wood to turn aside a sweeping blow.

name: Gust Bowl
description: Gather the charge's whole weight through the point and release it so one strike breaks a rider's guard and tears him from the saddle.

name: Iron Momentum
description: Concentrate qi into the point's edge and punch it into a plate seam through to the padding below.

name: Equipoise Counterbalance
description: Hold the long lance level through the run with the rest taking most of its weight.

name: Waning Counterbalance
description: Settle the eye along the couched shaft and fix the point's line before the horse breaks into the charge.

name: Trouncing Vamplate
description: Lean into the saddle and extend the arm so the point lands an instant before the horse closes.

name: Glancing Tilt
description: Wheel the horse toward the shield side after the pass to keep the guarded flank toward the foe.

name: Glint Impact
description: Extend the qi field a short way past the iron so the thrust bites before the point arrives.

name: Coronel Fastness
description: Let the shaft flex under a qi-loaded grip and spring a blow off the wood.

name: Renewing Graper
description: Shift the butt along the rest with a pulse of qi to rebalance the lance mid-run.

name: Splintering Couchrest
description: Throw the qi field ahead of the couched point so the thrust lands before the horse reaches the target.

name: Adamant Lanceguard Plating
description: Sweep the extended qi field across the horse's front to turn aside several strokes in one pass.

name: Invigorating Lancehead
description: Lean the body against the wheel's pull so the lance stays level on the curve.

name: Remnant Bellrest
description: Glance past the outside shoulder during the turn to mark where the enemy line is sliding.

name: Impactassault
description: Cut the inside track of the curve and strike a foe whose guard faces the wrong way.

name: Granite Ride
description: Straighten the horse at the end of the wheel and drive the point forward in one line.

name: Resilient Vamplate
description: Let the butt trail wide on the turn and swing it across to turn off a pursuer's cut.

name: Gustvamp
description: Tighten the horse's path in a spiral so each stride closes the gap to the enemy's flank.

name: Intent Coronel
description: Carry qi along the lance on the curve so the point stays on its mark through the wheel.

name: Ironvamp
description: Whip the shaft round at the top of the pivot with qi in its length to cut across a foe's guard.

name: Saddleassault
description: Bend the thrust along the wheel with a pulse of qi so the point seeks a covered flank.

name: Rumblesaddle
description: Carry the speed of the wheel into the point so the strike at its end hits with the full turn behind it.

name: Intenttilt
description: Ride a tightening spiral round a flank and press the enemy line inward with a ring of qi at the point.

name: Might Arrestrest
description: Match the horse's stride to the partner's, knee to knee, so both lances level together.

name: Invigorating Lanceshaft
description: Seat the butt in the rest on a shared count so both lances drop level at once.

name: Tearing Graper
description: Strike down the lane assigned to the rider and leave the partner's lane untouched.

name: Equipoise Lancehead
description: Angle the shaft to cover the partner's open flank while the partner covers the rider's.

name: Chimevamp
description: Glance sideways to keep the gap between the two horses steady through the run.

name: Might Shatter
description: Turn both mounts together on the inside and outside of a bend like two banks of a river.

name: Facetsaddle
description: Land the thrust a half-beat after the partner's so the second point meets an opened guard.

name: Daybreak Counterbalance
description: Beat the same qi pulse down both riders' reins so the horses surge in time.

name: Unyielding Couchrest
description: Cross both riders' shafts in front of the pair with qi in the wood to fend a sweeping blow.

name: Lanceguard Hauberk
description: Lift an enemy's lance shaft clear of the partner's flank with a quick upward flick.

name: Graperassault
description: Bring both lances onto one spot at once with joined qi so the pair drives a single wedge through a shield line.

name: Tempered Impact
description: Swap lanes at the instant of contact so each shaft strikes while it turns aside the foe's counter.

name: Saddlelinctus
description: Sit tall and still at the top of a slope, reading the target below before the run begins.

name: Blaze Coronel
description: Let the point fall from above the horse's head onto a target lower than the rider.

name: Mightgraper
description: Spread the elbows wide and low to absorb the downhill lurch into the rest.

name: Soaring Ride
description: Keep the horse's weight on its haunches down a slope so the charge builds without a stumble.

name: Graperplating
description: Clamp the shaft in a tight grip and snap it aside to knock down an upward thrust.

name: Facet Arrestrest
description: Add a dive of qi to the downward thrust so the point punches through a raised shield.

name: Rumble Momentum
description: Hook a foe's helm strap with the point after the dive and pull as the horse rises.

name: Waning Vamplate
description: Lock the gaze on one point of the target and let qi sharpen sight through the whole descent.

name: Lanceshaft Thrash
description: Gather qi above the head as the horse starts down, then release the whole fall into one piercing blow.

name: Torrent Vamplate
description: Sweep the shaft across the horse's chest and bank away over the foe's head before a counter lands.

name: Granite Shatter
description: Hold the horse to a high-kneed stride through shallow water so the point does not dip.

name: Blaze Impact
description: Strike through the spray at a rider mid-crossing before his horse finds its footing.

name: Torrent Bellrest
description: Lift the shaft against the bank side to turn off a thrust from a rider on higher ground.

name: Saddleremedy
description: Read the pull of the current on the horse's legs to choose the firm bed for the next stride.

name: Ironbowl
description: Drive a qi-loaded thrust across the water to the far bank in one lunge.

name: Hoarfrost Coronel
description: Sweep the shaft through the water's surface with qi to throw a screen of spray against thrusts.

name: Momentum Torment
description: Build the horse's speed through the shallows and release it into one thrust that stops a rider midstream.

name: Saddlecuirass
description: Plant horse and lance across a narrow crossing and bar riders from passing with a qi-hardened shaft.

name: Vampelixir
description: Lean the seat into the wind to feel which way it shoves the horse and shaft.

name: Fortifying Lanceshaft
description: Hold the point steady against a crosswind by bracing the wrist and resting the butt in the rest.

name: Gust Graper
description: Approach from the windward side so the gust pushes the charge toward the target.

name: Might Bowl
description: Set the point along a chosen bearing and thrust once the wind and horse agree.

name: Nova Tilt
description: Time the thrust to a gust so a pulse of qi and the wind land together.

name: Gust Bellrest
description: Turn the shaft to the lee side and let the wind carry a thrust away from the rider.

name: Fortifying Arrestrest
description: Read the wind in the flutter of a cord tied below the point and correct the line.

name: Counterbalance Thrash
description: Ride a rising gust down the shaft and release it into the point at the instant of contact.

name: Siltride
description: Hold the chosen bearing through a turn and sweep the point round to strike along it.

name: Silt Lancehead
description: Hold the horse to a measured pace along the plateau's edge so the line stays straight.

name: Nursing Graper
description: Speak the oath-phrase under the breath as the lance drops into the rest and the grip sets.

name: Bowl Maelstrom
description: Strike a foe on bare ground with the full reach of the shaft and no cover to dodge behind.

name: Torrent Couchrest
description: Lift the shaft on the cliff side to turn off a thrust from a rider closing along the edge.

name: Heartening Lanceguard
description: Fix the eye on a far mark across the plateau and hold the lance on its bearing.

name: Torrent Tilt
description: Wheel the horse about while keeping the bearing so the next run begins on the same line.

name: Tiltthrash
description: Set qi behind the point with the sworn resolve and drive it through a raised shield.

name: Implacable Arrestrest
description: Stir a veil of plateau dust with the shaft and qi to turn a thrust off its aim.

name: Intent Lanceguard
description: Beat a steady pulse of qi down the reins so the whole line keeps one pace.

name: Wrecking Momentum
description: Run the plateau's edge with the oath behind the lance and break the foe's line in a single blow.

name: Aegis Lancehead
description: Plant the lance and hold the sworn line with a field of qi that blunts every rider's push against it.

name: Granite Bowl
description: Lengthen the stride across open plain so the point leads the horse into the foe.

name: Might Vamplate
description: Lean forward with the gale at the back so the wind drives the rider onto the lance.

name: Iron Impact
description: Swing the point in a wide arc across an exposed foe and cut as the horse passes.

name: Grapergreave
description: Angle the shaft with a gust behind it to push an incoming thrust out wide.

name: Waning Lanceshaft
description: Scan the whole plain at once to mark where the foe's riders bunch and where they scatter.

name: Bounding Ride
description: Wheel with the tailwind pushing the horse round so the turn costs no speed.

name: Unmaking Counterbalance
description: Press a gust of qi along the shaft so the thrust bores through an unguarded chest.

name: Momentum Maelstrom
description: Shear the point across a line of riders with qi so it clips each stirrup in turn.

name: Compressing Bellrest
description: Hook the shaft round an exposed rider's arm and drag him off his line.

name: Chime Counterbalance
description: Throw the shaft upward on a rising current of qi to carry a falling blow over the head.

name: Tempered Ride
description: Ride the gale across open plain and release its force through the point in one unchecked charge.

name: Stifling Mayhem Impact
description: Sweep the lance in a wide arc with a burst of wind and qi to scatter bunched foes.
